folds.heading: ## Local brainstorm character-body reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B67)
folds.body: The seven [character draft lenses](audits/local_churn_2026-10-20/TRIAGE.md#character-bodies-reviewed-2026-11-04-b67), items 1–12 each, have now had their bodies read. Preserve useful memory/custody/communication/personality cases as optional applications of existing D7–D10, I1–I5 and V1–V5. A long relationship may change through real experience; no fixed personality cap, compulsory morale/loyalty decay, automatic successor inheritance or invented paused-time activity follows. Memory summaries preserve durable identity, promises, owned items and knowledge carriers; a foreign catalogue omission does not demand conversion of carried goods. Public clues need actual observation, not a hidden-motive/loyalty reveal or mandatory tooltip citation. Companion independence includes refusal and lawful separate ownership; it need not resolve into compliance. New UI layouts, caps, fixtures and a character creator remain proposals under AD32. No runtime absence/defect was established by the drafts.

folds.heading: ## Local brainstorm rival continuity reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B67)
folds.body: Character draft ordinals are retained in the [body-review ledger](audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b67.json). Their rival-growth, re-entry, alliance and memory suggestions fit the existing chronicle when actual actor goals, time, resources, witnessed information and committed aftermath supply them. An old rival may remain weaker, retire, cooperate or end the dispute; no player-level rubber band, endless hostility, mandatory immunity/counter or forced encounter follows. Costs and tradeoffs arise where the actual mechanism supplies them, including supported free means under AD5/AD38. Durable life state is separate from temporary combat reset; successor and returned actor identity are not interchangeable. No new rival simulator, old-save migration or implemented behavior is claimed.

folds.heading: ## Character bodies reviewed, 2026-11-04 (B67)
folds.body: The original title-only triage above remains dated history. B67 freshly read all seven character output files, all 84 numbered item bodies; [per-file ordinals and actual dispositions](../reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b67.json) preserve useful applications and reject unsupported universal defaults. The remaining dialogue/world bodies have not gained coverage from this batch. “About 8 new” was a novelty estimate, not verified runtime defects or acceptance. The drop grouping does not imply accessibility/readability is deferred with mobile: desktop usability retains its own current UI authority. Character creation, crowd/detail tools and provenance ideas stay preserved as optional proposals under AD32, rather than being erased or silently selected.
